svg.title: SolveSequential: prioritized planning over the event DAG
svg.desc: Setup once, then one pass over the events in topological order. AGV and tray events are planned by SIPP on the AGV's safe-interval table with every other entity frozen at its last pose; bay and VECS events get fixed durations. A final pairwise collision check returns the ContinuousState or nullopt.

g.text: AGV-2 may enter 9 only after 6 s. Its goal is 12, and reaching 12 counts only because 12 stays safe

g.text: forever afterwards. That rule plus the freeze is why an AGV that has not yet been planned to leave a

g.text: SolveSequential: prioritized planning over the event DAG

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: One pass in topological order, never revisited. Only AGV moves are searched; everything else gets a fixed duration. Safety comes from safe-interval tables, then a final pairwise check.
